test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

During vacations, Geeta saw a __saltwater lake separated from the sea by rocks and sand__ where she did kayak for the first time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lagoon"** refers to a stretch of saltwater separated from the sea by a low sandbank or coral reef. (खाड़ी)

 
 
• **Example: **The serene lagoon was perfect for a peaceful kayak ride.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. lagoon**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **River **(नदी): A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

 
 
• **Example:** The Nile River is the longest river in the world.
 
 
 
• **Ditch **(खाई): A narrow channel dug in the ground, typically used for drainage.
 
 
• **Example: **The construction workers dug a ditch to lay the pipes.
 
 
 
• **Sea** (समुद्र): The expanse of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface.
 
 
• **Example:** We enjoyed a boat ride on the open sea.
